title: 提交 DAG 的 merge-base（最近公共祖先）与可达性判定
expected_output:
=== 场景 1：单基点分叉  X->A; A->B,C; M=merge(B,C) ===
  merge-base(B, C) = A
  merge-base(M, M) = M
  merge-base --all (B, C) = ['A']
  可达性: A 从 B 可达? True ；B 从 A 可达? False
  快进判定(head=B, source=C): False
  ahead/behind(local=M, upstream=C) = (2, 0)

=== 场景 2：交叉合并 history（criss-cross，两个基点）===
  merge-base(M1, M2) 单一结果 = A
  merge-base --all (M1, M2) = ['A', 'B']  （两个并列基点）
  Git 的行为: 存在多基点时用 recursive 策略先合成一个虚拟 base，再做三方合并

=== 场景 3：祖先集合大小与 ahead/behind（分支分歧度）===
  共同祖先 c5 之后: feature 领先 2 个提交，落后主干 3 个提交
  分歧度(ahead+behind) = 5
  可达提交总数 f2: 8 ；u3: 9
code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""merge-base = 两节点在 commit DAG 上的最近公共祖先（LCA）。
从一侧 BFS 分层扩展，第一个落在另一侧祖先集合里的节点即『最近』。"""
from collections import deque


class DAG:
    def __init__(self, parents):
        self.parents = parents

    def ancestors(self, start):
        seen, stack = set(), [start]
        while stack:
            n = stack.pop()
            if n in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(n)
            stack.extend(self.parents.get(n, []))
        return seen

    def merge_base(self, a, b):
        anc_a = self.ancestors(a)
        q, seen = deque([b]), set()
        while q:
            n = q.popleft()
            if n in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(n)
            if n in anc_a:
                return n
            q.extend(self.parents.get(n, []))
        return None

    def merge_base_all(self, a, b):
        """git merge-base --all：极大共同祖先（其子节点不再同时属于两者的祖先集）。"""
        anc_a, anc_b = self.ancestors(a), self.ancestors(b)
        common = anc_a & anc_b
        children = {c: [n for n, ps in self.parents.items() if c in ps] for c in self.parents}
        maximal = [c for c in common if not any(ch in common for ch in children.get(c, []))]
        return sorted(maximal)

    def ahead_behind(self, local, upstream):
        """git rev-list --left-right --count local...upstream 的口径。"""
        anc_l, anc_u = self.ancestors(local), self.ancestors(upstream)
        return len(anc_l - anc_u), len(anc_u - anc_l)


print("=== 场景 1：单基点分叉  X->A; A->B,C; M=merge(B,C) ===")
simple = {"X": [], "A": ["X"], "B": ["A"], "C": ["A"], "M": ["B", "C"]}
g1 = DAG(simple)
print("  merge-base(B, C) = %s" % g1.merge_base("B", "C"))
print("  merge-base(M, M) = %s" % g1.merge_base("M", "M"))
print("  merge-base --all (B, C) = %s" % g1.merge_base_all("B", "C"))
print("  可达性: A 从 B 可达? %s ；B 从 A 可达? %s" % ("A" in g1.ancestors("B"), "B" in g1.ancestors("A")))
print("  快进判定(head=B, source=C): %s" % ("B" in g1.ancestors("C")))
print("  ahead/behind(local=M, upstream=C) = %s" % (g1.ahead_behind("M", "C"),))
print()

print("=== 场景 2：交叉合并 history（criss-cross，两个基点）===")
cc = {
    "X": [], "A": ["X"], "B": ["X"],
    "M1": ["A", "B"], "M2": ["A", "B"],
    "T": ["M1", "M2"],
}
g2 = DAG(cc)
allb = g2.merge_base_all("M1", "M2")
print("  merge-base(M1, M2) 单一结果 = %s" % g2.merge_base("M1", "M2"))
print("  merge-base --all (M1, M2) = %s  （两个并列基点）" % allb)
print("  Git 的行为: 存在多基点时用 recursive 策略先合成一个虚拟 base，再做三方合并")
print()

print("=== 场景 3：祖先集合大小与 ahead/behind（分支分歧度）===")
long_hist = {"c0": []}
prev = "c0"
for i in range(1, 6):
    long_hist["c%d" % i] = [prev]
    prev = "c%d" % i
fork = prev
long_hist["f1"] = [fork]
long_hist["f2"] = ["f1"]
long_hist["u1"] = [fork]
long_hist["u2"] = ["u1"]
long_hist["u3"] = ["u2"]
g3 = DAG(long_hist)
ahead, behind = g3.ahead_behind("f2", "u3")
print("  共同祖先 c5 之后: feature 领先 %d 个提交，落后主干 %d 个提交" % (ahead, behind))
print("  分歧度(ahead+behind) = %d" % (ahead + behind))
print("  可达提交总数 f2: %d ；u3: %d" % (len(g3.ancestors("f2")), len(g3.ancestors("u3"))))
